raw: I remember finding a dead mouse in a watering can. Its tail was sticking out of the spout, and there was this rancid smell coming from inside. That’s what really disgusted me—the smell, together with realizing what the little tail belonged to. It wasn’t just dirty water or something that needed rinsing out. There was a dead animal in there. I didn’t want to get close enough to look any more carefully. Even remembering it, it’s that combination of the tail and the smell that comes back to me.
